name: print-social-find-your-style-post-black-orange-split-with-circle-portrait
title: 'Find Your Style & Your Self.' post split black and orange with a circle portrait and arc segments
whatItIs: A square post split vertically into black and orange, with a circle-cropped portrait of a woman straddling the split (greyscale on the black side, warm on the orange), thin white arc segments around the circle, three small squares, and a white and orange headline.
whatItMeans: Stylish and dual; the split portrait suggests two sides of a personality.
techniques: Split the background and the portrait along the same line.
Desaturate the half of the photo on the dark side.
Orbit thin arc segments around a circle crop.

vocabulary.definition: A layout divided into two contrasting halves.
